title: DiscussionRequest
description: A question queued for a crew on kubemoot.request.<namespace>.<crew>. The crew's coordinator takes requests one at a time and starts a thread for each.

conversationId.description: The conversation the question continues, or a new one.

crew.description: The crew. The coordinator publishes the thread under this crew.

timestamp.description: When the request was queued, RFC 3339 in UTC.

use_rag.description: Whether the crew may use knowledge retrieval. The coordinator reads it and does not act on it.

use_tools.description: Whether the crew may use tools. The coordinator reads it and does not act on it.
